fusions.name: Spores on the Draught
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles of you is caught by a spore-laden gust that deals 10 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each one then spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Ripe Cap Bursts
fusions.desc: Sends a dart of air into the first enemy it meets that deals 18 damage, using up every affliction you have on the target and dealing 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Drifting Puffball
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a drifting spore cloud for 10 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Mycelial Reach
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
